analyst.summary: AXISCADES Technologies provides engineering services to the aerospace and defence sectors, a segment with a genuine tailwind from India's defence-indigenization push, and has grown revenue 12% in FY26 with a good 5-year track record (17% revenue CAGR, 21% profit CAGR). However, an unusually high tax charge in the most recent quarter dragged reported full-year profit down, making the headline ~85 times earnings look more extreme than the underlying run-rate suggests; even normalized, we estimate the effective multiple is still a full ~60-65 times earnings against an approximately 11% return on equity. We rate this a Sell on valuation.
